e.title: lifecontingencies (R)
e.summary: R 生命表与寿险精算数学库：精算现值、年金、准备金
e.body: lifecontingencies 是 R 的生命表与寿险精算数学包：构建生命表、计算 [[actuarial-present-value]]、年金与准备金。与 [[mortality-table]]、[[longevity-risk]]、[[retirement-planning]] 词条直接呼应，覆盖寿险方向的精算计算。
e.verified_note: 文档核实：CRAN 包页确认（生命表/精算数学），未实测
e.summary_en: R package for life tables and actuarial mathematics: actuarial present values, annuities, reserves
e.summary_hk: R 生命表與壽險精算數學庫：精算現值、年金、準備金
e.body_en: lifecontingencies is the R package for life tables and life-insurance actuarial mathematics: building life tables and computing [[actuarial-present-value]], annuities and reserves. It maps to entries like [[mortality-table]], [[longevity-risk]] and [[retirement-planning]] — the life-side actuarial calculator.
e.body_hk: lifecontingencies 是 R 的生命表與壽險精算數學包：構建生命表、計算 [[actuarial-present-value]]、年金與準備金。與 [[mortality-table]]、[[longevity-risk]]、[[retirement-planning]] 詞條直接呼應，覆蓋壽險方向的精算計算。
